rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the Court on the narrow, institutional path of a standing dismissal grounded in Gill/Lance and Clapper-style limits on speculative, third-party-dependent harms. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito/Barrett/Gorsuch to sharpen competitor-standing boundaries and emphasize Article III constraints (and possibly to signal views on the underlying Election Day statutes without reaching the merits).
